The Caesar cipher shifts each letter in the alphabet by a fixed number of positions. In this case, shifting each letter back by 3 positions:

- Z -> W
- k -> h
- r -> o

- d -> a
- u -> r
- h -> e

- b -> y
- r -> o
- x -> u

So, "Zkr duh brx?" becomes "Who are you?"
